title: The nightly VAT retry has never run: CRON_SECRET is not set in production
body: Task 10.5 is closed and 10.14 is "in progress", but the endpoint is live and refusing to work. label: Hardening — not a blocker
title: Five SECURITY DEFINER helpers are published as public RPC endpoints
body: is_admin, is_admin_or_cs, my_assigned_request_ids, my_professional_ids and now can_see_request_address (mig 044) are reachable at /rest/v1/rpc/*. They expose no data — each answers only about the caller's own permissions — but they have no reason to sit in the public API. IMPORTANT: the advisor's suggested remedy, revoking EXECUTE, is wrong here. 19 policies across 9 tables call these functions, and a policy expression is evaluated with the querying role's own privileges, so revoking EXECUTE would break signed-in access across the whole app. The correct fix is to move them into a non-exposed schema (private.) and update the 19 policies to the qualified name, in a single migration. Not urgent, but do it as one deliberate change, not opportunistically.
evidence: Supabase security advisor 2026-08-07: 10 WARN of anon/authenticated_security_definer_function_executable, zero ERROR, zero RLS-missing. pg_policy scan found 19 dependent policies on request_addresses, requests, profiles, users, professionals, professional_services, request_messages, request_professionals, city_waitlist. Codebase has zero .rpc() calls, so nothing in the app depends on these being callable over REST.

label: Healed — worth a tidy
title: Migration drift is documented and functionally closed — but the live history still has five orphan names
body: 036 and 037 were applied in production without repo files. Migration 038 was written to be self-sufficient and idempotent, so a fresh clone reproduces production correctly — the drift rule worked. What remains is cosmetic but affects tooling: five names in the live history have no matching file (portfolio_pro_limit_1, 034b, 034c, 036, 037), 011_customer_memory has a file but no history row, and numbering has collided three times (029, 034 x3, 042 x2). Until that is reconciled, `supabase db diff` cannot be trusted as a check.
evidence: 49 live migrations vs 44 repo files · 038_verification_review_and_admin_queue.sql: "applicate in produzione ma SENZA file in repo (drift da sanare)"
